reviewMethod: AI-assisted, case-by-case review of seven selected official permit descriptions; not an independent accuracy assessment.
sampling: All seven newly observed matches from the September 28 comparison; not a random or market-wide sample.

fieldGuide.scopeEvidence: Paraphrased work/material families explicitly described in the source; not quantities or available contracts.
fieldGuide.originalTradeKeywordMatches: Original simple-rule labels retained for comparison, including empty arrays.
fieldGuide.proposedUse: Use described for the affected space, separated from the existing building context.
fieldGuide.pursuitDecision: Left null for a buyer's own decision; no automated prospect qualification.

limitations: Research preview only; no paid permit service or open-bid evidence.
Newly observed means absent from the prior local snapshot, not a new customer or newly available purchasing opportunity.
Issued permits may already have contractors or suppliers. Actual procurement status, quantities and supplier budgets remain unknown.
No raw descriptions, names, addresses, contact information or tenant identities retained.
No live commercial service, paid delivery, demand or settlement is verified.

items.reviewNote: The mixed-use keyword describes the existing building; scope is limited to a ground-floor daycare. Specific materials and mechanical/electrical/plumbing packages are not enumerated.

items.scopeStage: occupancy conversion, interior alteration and one-story addition
items.existingContext: existing commercial building / former medical use
items.reviewNote: Commercial is existing-building context. The proposed use is religious assembly; do not treat this as medical fit-out demand.
Several material/work families are explicit, but quantities, specifications and unawarded packages are unknown.
Warehouse refers to existing space being converted to offices. A warehouse-equipment prospect would be unsupported. Specific trade/material packages are not enumerated.
Interior scope is explicit; named occupants were omitted. No quantity, supplier selection or remaining purchasing window is established.
Mechanical and electrical work are explicit; plumbing is not enumerated. Do not expand this to a complete MEP package.
Office/lobby alterations are supported; specific products, quantities and plumbing scope are unspecified.
